  [Life Sciences]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Life Sciences overview][188]
  **Real-World Data**
  [NLP-Enriched EHR Data Solutions][189] Large-scale, high-quality health data sets.
  **Real-World Evidence**
  [Real-World Evidence][190] Retrospective and prospective research by RWE experts.
  [Real-World Evidence Analytics Platform][191] SaaS application enabling efficient analysis of
  real-world data.
  **Point of Care Marketing**
  [Digital Health Media][192] Highly targeted brand awareness messaging in the EHR.*
* [Health Plans + Payers][193]
  [Health Plan Payers]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Health Plans + Payers overview][194]
  **Gap Closure**
  [Gap Closure Services][195] Proactive, clinically-driven services to help health plans and their
  network providers close care gaps.
  [Care Gap Alerting][196] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Provider Engagement Solutions][197] Streamlined payer-provider collaboration for better gap
  closure.
  **Risk Adjustment**
  [Health Equity Analytics][198] Go beyond Social Determinants of Health (SDoH).
  [Risk Adjustment Analytics][199] Analytics to find and prioritize gaps and opportunities.
  [Risk Mitigator][200] RADV audits - be prepared, not scared.
  [Comprehensive Submissions][201] One cloud-based data management platform for all government
  programs.
  [Utilization Analytics][202] Delivers visibility needed to monitor and manage key performance
  indicators.
  **Data Exchange + Coding**
  [eChart Courier][203] Automated electronic chart retrieval.
  [eChart Coder][204] Boost productivity and reduce costs with Veradigm eChart Coder.
  [eChart Integration and Analytics][205] Automated exchange of clinical data and medical record
  information for analysis.
  **Quality Management**
  [Quality Analytics][206] Proven analytic solution to help plans enhance Quality performance across
  their member base.
  [Risk Adjustment and Quality Management][207] Real-time visibility to monitor and manage your KPIs
  for risk and quality alike.
  **Clearinghouse + EDI**
  [Veradigm Payerpath][208] Claims and risk adjustment solution including an effective collaboration
  delivering streamlined EDI.
* [Healthcare Providers][209]
  [Healthcare Provider]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare Providers overview][210]
  **Our Platform**
  [Veradigm Suite][211] Explore Veradigm’s powerful healthcare solutions designed to streamline
  operations, improve patient care, and boost practice efficiency.
  **Streamline Practice Operations**
  [Practice Management][212] Simplified software for effortless scheduling, billing, and claims
  processing.
  [AI Patient Scheduling][213] Automate and optimize patient scheduling with artificial
  intelligence.
  **Improve Clinical Efficiency**
  [EHR Software][214] Adaptable ambulatory EHR platform that supports your clinical documentation
  and workflow needs.
  [ePrescribe][215] Affordable and certified e-Prescribing solution including controlled substances.
  [Gap Closure Alerting][216] Point-of-care care gap alerting.
  [Clinical Data Registries][217] Registry participation for providers.
  [eChart Courier][218] Save time, reduce costs, and increase efficiency by automating medical chart
  retrieval.
  **Maximize Revenue**
  [Revenue Cycle Services][219] Let us handle billing, minimize denials, enhance coding, and ensure
  timely payments.
  [Coding Services][220] Get help to reduce staff burden and increase revenue - let our team manage
  coding for you.
  [Veradigm Payerpath][221] All-in-one revenue cycle management solution that features a top-tier
  clearinghouse.
  [Veradigm Intelligent Payments][222] Simplify patient billing and boost collections with
  intelligent, automated payments.
  **Engage Patients**
  [Patient Engagement Platform][223] Integrate with a mobile-first patient engagement platform.
  **Optimize Resources and Spend**
  [ERP Fiscal Management][224] Automate finance workflows and improve visibility into spend,
  reporting, and compliance.
  [ERP Point of Use][225] Track supply usage in clinical settings to reduce waste and improve
  accuracy.
  [ERP Supply Chain][226] Streamline purchasing and inventory with real-time visibility from
  requisition to delivery.
* [Health IT Vendors][227]
  [Veradigm Network]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Start with our Healthcare IT Vendor Solutions overview][228]
  **Powered by the Network**
  [Life Sciences][229] Empowering life science with trusted data and insights from the point of
  care.
  [Health Plans + Payers][230] Connecting payers to the Veradigm Network’s comprehensive, national
  provider footprint.
  [Providers][231] Integrated clinical & financial solutions for a healthier practice.
  **API Connectivity**
  [Veradigm Connect][232] Connect the latest health tech solutions with the physicians and patients
  who need them.
  [App Expo][233] Become one of hundreds of certified applications and devices for provider
  practices built on open APIs.
  [Diagnostic Ordering and Results Network (DORN)][234] Connecting EHR Vendors with Lab and
  Radiology centers.
  **Electronic Prescribing**
  [Veradigm ePrescribe Enterprise][235] Integrated, advanced, easy-to-use ePrescribing for EHR and
  HIT vendors.
* [Insights][236]
  [Two hands typing on a laptop]
  
  Not sure what you're looking for?
  
  [Filter through all of Veradigm's Insights][237]
  **Veradigm Insights**
  [Blog Posts][238] Read through our collection of valuable insights.
  [Videos][239] Watch our videos to learn more about our offerings.
  [Thought Leadership][240] Read the latest healthcare insights from our team of subject matter
  experts.
  [Podcasts][241] Listen to our podcasts to hear healthcare insights from our team of experts.
  [Webinars][242] Watch our webinars to learn more about how we are transforming health,
  insightfully.
  **Resources**
  [RWE Publications][243] Read through our RWE publications and learn how we help clients.
  [Clinical Data Registries][244] Explore our registry publications and learn how we help clients.
  [*Smart Medicine* Podcast][245] Thought-provoking podcast dedicated to understanding the
  intersection of care and innovation
  **Trending Topics**
  [Value-Based Care][246] Comprehensive guide to value-based care, including use cases, relevant
  blog articles, white papers and more.
  [Real-World Evidence][247] Complete overview of real-world evidence, why it’s important, and how
  it’s used in healthcare.
  [Real-World Data][248] Thorough review of what real-world healthcare data is, how it’s collected,
  and how it’s used across the healthcare spectrum.
  [Payer Provider Relationships Guide][249] Discover the impact of payer-provider relationships on
  healthcare. Learn how collaboration improves patient care and addresses challenges.

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## Revolutionizing the farmer experience, online and onsite.

FarmerCore introduces more convenience for farmers by bringing the entire business to the farm,
putting them at the forefront of a customer-centric network that provides a seamless experience.

[ FarmerCore ][91]
[Silhouette of farmer in field]

## Today’s challenges are tomorrow’s possibilities.

Our purpose at AGCO is to provide farmer-focused solutions to sustainably feed our world. Our
ambition is to accelerate innovation and efficiency to drive positive outcomes for farmers and the
planet. 

[ Read our 2025 Sustainability Report ][92]

challenges and triumphs of farmers.

## AGCO. Where extraordinary grows.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do
for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work,
building a better and more sustainable world. Join us! 

[ Careers ][98]
[ [AGCO - Your Agriculture Company - Red and white logo] ][99]
AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for

# Family Medicine and Wellness in Philadelphia, PA

[Sign — Clinics & Medical Centers in Philadelphia, PA]
At Ashton Family Medicine we deliver high quality patient-centered medical care to patients in the
Greater Philadelphia Area including Northeast Philadelphia, Bensalem, Feasterville-Trevose,
Southampton and Huntingdon Valley. We accept patients of all ages from newborn to geriatrics.

We strive to keep our patients healthy by providing pediatric well visits, adolescent physicals,
preventative services including vaccinations, and geriatric annual visits. In addition to routine
preventative care we also offer acute care visits and chronic disease management.

We also assist our patients in self-management of chronic diseases to given the patient control over
their chronic disease instead of the disease controlling the patient. Our focus is on the patient as
a whole person and it is our job to insure that our patients not only get physical care but
behavioral health services and support as well.

# [Meet the Doctors][19]

[Get to know the doctors at Ashton Family Medicine & Wellness Center before you schedule an
appointment. Our doctors have a wide range of experience and are ready to care for you.][20]
[circular-clock3]
Office Hours
Monday - Thursday 8 am - 8pm
Friday 8 am - 4 pm
Saturday 8 am - 12 pm
[circular-clock3]
Established Patients Needing Medical Advice When The
Office Is Closed Should Call Our Main Number To Be
Connected To Our Answering Service.
[(215) 632-4550][21]

# Why Ashton Family Medicine?
1.  We strive to meet the physical, mental, preventative, acute, and chronic care needs of our
    patients.
2.  We utilize the latest Information Technology to prescribe, track test result, and obtain
    clinical support information.
3.  Foster relationship based care built on respect of patients' unique needs, cultures, values, and
    preferences.
4.  We actively involve patients and support patients in self managing and organizing their own
    care.
5.  We strive to coordinate across all elements of patient care. *This includes care from
    specialists, hospitals, home health care, and community services.
6.  We help patients through transitions of care like discharges from the hospitals and
    rehabilitation facilities.
7.  We have regular extended patient office hours beyond normal 9 to 5 business hours.
8.  We strive to achieve excellent communication among patients, physicians and staff so that you
    understand your condition and your treatment options.
9.  We respond promptly to all patients phone calls. If your doctor is not in the office and you
    need answers to medical questions, another physician is available to answer questions that can
    not wait until your doctor returns.
10. We notify patients in a timely manner of all test results.
11. We use evidence based medicine.
12. We engage in physician and office performance measurement and strive to improve on a regular
    basis.
13. We regularly measure patient experience and satisfaction by using a suggestion box and random
    patient satisfaction surveys.
14. We offer patient online access to their patient health information and other services via the
    patient portal.
15. We offer patients a handicap accessible facility with free off-street parking.

# How You Can Help Us Take Better Care of You

To effectively serve as your medical home we ask that you help by keeping us informed of any care
you received outside of the office. If you see another physician we ask that you inform them that we
are your primary care office and ask that they send us a summary of the care they provide you. We
also ask that you inform our care team of any change in medication ordered by a physician outside
our office so we may keep your records up to date. Please notify our office if you are seen in a
hospital, whether it is for an ER visit, an urgent admission, or an admission for an outpatient
procedure. We will be able to coordinate your follow up care in a more efficient way if we are aware
of your outside care.
**
A Division of Pinnacle Physicians Group, LLC | We accept most insurance plans—ask about it at our
front desk! Please note that a $25 dollar fee will be given if you fail to cancel your appointment
less than 24 hours or no show to your appointment. **

any questions.

**If you are experiencing an emergency, ****please call 911!**

MEDICAID RENEWALS

**Medicaid renewals have begun. For those Avenue 360 Health + Wellness patients on Medicaid, it’s
time to update your information to keep your access to doctor visits, medications, and more.**

**Your local Medicaid office will send you a letter or a renewal form to complete. Please complete
your renewal by the due date printed on the form. If you don’t, you could lose your coverage.  Don’t
risk losing your coverage due to paperwork. **

**We understand that redetermining your eligibility for Medicaid can be confusing and we’re here to
help. ****Don’t wait, call [713-426-0027][72] now. Your coverage depends on it.**

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.

* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

chronic disease management. We welcome new patients. Please don't hesitate to call **Biltmore Family

# FAMILY MEDICAL CLINIC IN ASHEVILLE, NC

At **Biltmore Family Medicine PLLC** , we strive to keep our patients healthy by providing pediatric
well visits, adolescent physicals, preventative services including **vaccinations, and geriatric
annual visits**. In addition to routine preventative care, we also offer acute care visits and
chronic disease management. We welcome new patients. Please don't hesitate to call **Biltmore Family
Medicine PLLC** to set up your next appointment.

Family members that are healthy are more likely to be happy and spend their time together. To help
with this, you should have a medical practice that can see all of you in one location. From your
children to your grandparents, make sure that everyone is taken care of. You will receive these
services and more at Biltmore Family Medicine PLLC.

## You have the right to receive a “*Good Faith Estimate*” explaining how much your medical care
## will cost

Under the law, health care providers need to give patients who don’t have insurance or who are not
using insurance an estimate of the bill for medical items and services. You have the right to
receive a Good Faith Estimate for the total expected cost of any non-emergency items or services.

Make sure your health care provider gives you a Good Faith Estimate in writing at least 1 business
day before your medical service or item. You can also ask your health care provider, and any other
provider you choose, for a Good Faith Estimate before you schedule an item or service. If you
receive a bill that is at least $400 more than your Good Faith Estimate, you can dispute the
bill. Make sure to save a copy or picture of your Good Faith Estimate.

Borinquen Medical Centers are Level 3 Patient Centered Medical Homes (PCMH) – NCQA’s highest
designation.

AAAHC Medical Home accreditation is a symbol of prestige that you can be truly proud of; a mark of
excellence honoring the fact that you adopt best practices and comply with nationally recognized
Standards of care. For your patients, it provides comforting reassurance that they will receive
high-quality care when they need it.

Borinquen Medical Centers of Miami-Dade is accredited by the Accreditation Association for
Ambulatory Health Care.

[CARF Accredited: Aspire to Excellence]

Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities accreditation signals a service provider’s
commitment to continually improving services, encouraging feedback, and serving the community

Borinquen Medical Centers of Miami-Dade is accredited by CARF International.

## You have questions.
## We have math.

### What is marketing debt?

Marketing debt is the compounding cost of budget decisions made on wrong attribution. Each quarter
you allocate spend on correlated numbers instead of causal evidence, the misallocation carries into
the next plan and grows. Like technical debt, but on the marketing P&L. A causal read on your GA4
export quantifies it per channel; see causalityengine.ai/marketing-debt for the full breakdown.

### What is attribution debt?

Attribution debt is the gap between what your ad platforms claim drove revenue and what actually
caused it, carried quarter after quarter into the budget. It is how marketing debt accrues: allocate
on claimed conversions long enough and the plan itself becomes the liability. Both terms are defined

you allocate spend on correlated numbers instead of causal evidence, the misallocation carries into

# Chronic Care Management, Value Based Care

Chronic Care Staffing^{®} is a nationwide provider of remote patient health services strictly
following CMS service guidelines. We work with an array of clients ranging from small practices to
large health systems. Working directly in the client EMR, our clinical team is scalable, ensuring a
fast ramp up, high participation and low drop out patient enrollment program. CCS has developed
industry leading documentation, population health initiatives and Value Based Reimbursement (VBR)
calling protocols which helps optimize remote patient care as well as client reimbursement.

[Learn More][72]

## Chronic Care Management(CCM, CPT 99490/99439)

CCM is a Medicare/Medicare Advantage program designed to reduce unnecessary ER visits and
hospitalizations. Patients are monitored in between office visits on a monthly basis. CCM can be
significant while providing a platform to improve clinical outcomes and close gaps in care.

[Read More][73]

## Behavioral Health Integration (BHI)

BHI programs are designed to serve patients with mild to moderate behavioral health needs,
particularly those with comorbid chronic conditions such as diabetes, heart disease, or
COPD—conditions that are often exacerbated by unmanaged depression or anxiety.

[Read More][74]

## Remote Patient Monitoring

Federal Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), Rural Health Clinics (RHCs), and Community Health Centers
(CHCs) may bill Medicare for Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI)
in combination with Chronic Care Management (CCM) when provided concurrently, supporting expanded
patient access, particularly in rural and underserved communities.

[Read More][75]

## Virtual Clinical Staff Augmentation

CCS can provide remote staff to augment your clinical team. CCS’s clinical staff (Multidisciplinary
skilled nurses) can perform a wide variety of virtual duties while charting in your EMR in real time
while identifying as a part of your practice.

[Read More][76]

## Health Risk Assessment (HRA) for Annual Wellness Visits(AWV, CPT G0438/G0439)

Annual Wellness Visits are an integral component of Value Based Care. Evidence suggests HRA use and
follow up interventions can positively influence health behaviors. AWVs help reduce health
disparities and improve health outcomes through identifying modifiable health risks.

[Read More][77]

## What Our Clients are Saying

Partnering with CCS has allowed us to address multiple drivers of emergency room utilization—by
educating patients about their chronic conditions so they can manage them better, encouraging and
facilitating access to primary care for non-emergent issues, and identifying smaller issues before
they become big ones, such as a medication change. This has been a huge benefit to our patients,
primary care teams, and broader health system!

I’ve worked with many vendors in the past and I honestly feel Chronic Care Staffing has been one
of—if not the best— partner I’ve ever engaged with.

CCS does a fabulous job. We have gone a long way toward improving people’s health, simply by
discovering the number of patients who were out of meds!! Patients comment that calls from action
items sent by you to us are resolved quickly, adding to feeling you’re just down the hall.

Managing Partner and MD of large family practice

CCS clinical approach has already produced great result. We ran a quick report on diabetes and it
shows that the patients enrolled in CCM are more likely to have received an updated A1c Screening as
well as their diabetic retinopathy and nephropathy screening. Also 78% of the diabetics in the CCM
program are controlled compared to 68% of our total population of diabetics.

Chief Clinical Officer of a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC)

I feel we have a great line of communication. The numbers reflect many patients are enrolling. I was
concerned many patients would be resistant due to the previous experiences but it does not appear to
be a problem. It is a pleasure for me to work with your team.

Program Administrator of a Medical Center

Our patients love the CCS nursing staff. They have coordinated with our providers seamlessly. We
have been very satisfied with our working relationship with Chronic Care Staffing.

Chief Medical Officer of a Regional Family and Internal Medicine Center

Chronic Care Staffing does a fabulous job getting so many patients on the phone. We have gone a long
way toward improving people’s health, simply by discovering the number of patients who were out of
meds!! Overall feedback from our patients is great. They are all convinced you are sequestered in
rear of building. They comment that calls from action items sent by you to us are resolved quickly,
adding to feeling you’re just down the hall (confidence).

Fabulous job

I love when patients answer the phone, know who I am and are excited to talk to me. I love the
flexibility and being able to work full time while still being present for my kids’ activities. I
have been a nurse for 17 years and have worked in so many different fields and this is my favorite
job I have had!

I like having goals and tasks set in front of me to achieve. I also like being able to still care
for my patients over the phone and be effective at it.

I love my job with Chronic Care Staffing. Out of all the specialties I have worked in, Chronic Care
Management has been my absolute favorite. I love that I have been able to create relationships with
my patients and they feel they can call on me anytime they need something.

Being a Care Coordinator with Chronic Care Staffing is such a rewarding position. From helping the
patients learn about their chronic conditions to helping them with finding resources to assist with
some of life’s struggles. Hearing them tell me how much they appreciate me and that they look
forward to my calls is just icing on the cake.

I’ve never worked for a company that is so supportive and caring. I work with an amazing team that
truly knows and shows what teamwork is all about. I am truly blessed to work for Chronic Care
Staffing with my amazing coworkers whom I now consider my friends.

I have never felt more successful in any professional role in my 40 year working career as I do with
CCS, and am proud to be a part of a fantastic company with great caring people.

disparities and improve health outcomes through identifying modifiable health risks.

____________________________________________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________________________________
 

In order to most effectively achieve the Quadruple Aim, all Rhode Islanders need access to strong
and vibrant primary care that engages patients and families and contributes to community
partnerships where they practice.

The CTC-RI Clinical Strategy Committee guided the development of a compilation of best practices
that maximize success in Comprehensive Primary Care Capitation (CPCC) and Total Cost of Care (TCOC)
models. This compilation includes a set of Common Standards that the group identified as “must have”
and “nice to have” elements of an approach to CPCC and TCOC.

This work will support primary care providers and their systems of care as they expand their
participation in these care delivery models as well as inform the work of the OHIC Payment and Care
Delivery Advisory Committee.

Click [here for the Adult Comprehensive Primary Care presentation][26] or click [here for the
Pediatric Comprehensive Primary Care presentation][27].

____________________________________________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________________________________

[CTCRI]

# Did you know...

Rhode Island ranks higher than all other states in terms of the number of physicians per capita that
are practicing in NCQA-recognized patient-centered medical homes?

# What is a patient-centered medical home?

The patient-centered medical home is a new way to provide healthcare. It is a model that improves
people's health and wellbeing by helping doctors proactively manage and coordinate care for their
patients, increasing the use of preventive care and regular screenings, and supporting people with
diabetes, depression, and other chronic diseases in new and innovative ways.

[Click here to learn more about what a patient-centered medical home is.][28]

## Our Mission

The mission of CTC-RI is to support the continuing transformation of primary care in Rhode Island as
the foundation of an ever-improving integrated, accessible, affordable, and equitable health care
system.  CTC-RI brings together critical stakeholders to implement, evaluate and spread effective
multi-payer models to deliver, pay for and sustain high-quality, comprehensive, accountable primary
care.

and vibrant primary care that engages patients and families and contributes to community
partnerships where they practice.

models. This compilation includes a set of Common Standards that the group identified as “must have”

diabetes, depression, and other chronic diseases in new and innovative ways.

Why Teams Switch

## Good instincts are nice.
## *Great data* are better.

People switch to DrugPatentWatch because they're tired of the high cost and low quality of their
analysts. You shouldn't have to wait for a report to understand your market.

Every drug is perpetually updatd from primary sources. The latest information is always available —
no delays, no filters, no spin.

[See why others have switched →][6]
Patent Expiry Opportunities — 2025–2030

Keytruda (pembrolizumab) 2028 High Value
Humira (adalimumab) Expired Generic
Eliquis (apixaban) 2026 Watch
Ozempic (semaglutide) 2032 Monitored
The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

[See the raw data →][7]
📥
Export everything, keep it forever
Download full datasets in clean, structured formats. Your exports belong to you — not to a
subscription you might cancel.
🔄
Updated while you sleep

# Personalizing Architecture

We specialize in hand-crafting healthcare, education,
commercial, and indigenous architecture.

[ DSGW's Unique Approach ][38]
[ View Featured Project ][39]

## Enriching Communities Through Healthcare Architecture Indigenous Architecture
## Education Architecture Commercial Architecture Sustainable Design Housing Workplace Design
## Civic Architecture Interior Design

After 85 years, we still believe that no matter where you live and work, every community deserves
great architecture. The best buildings reflect the character of a region whether its in a rural or
urban area. We excel at collaborating, listening and designing for you.

## Building a Future of Learning

###### ROCK RIDGE HIGH SCHOOL | MINNESOTA

At DSGW Architecture, we believe that great schools do more than educate — they inspire, connect,
and strengthen communities. That vision came to life with the Rock Ridge High School project,
designed for the communities of Gilbert, Eveleth, and Virginia in Minnesota. This state-of-the-art
facility blends the region’s rich mining heritage, its geological landscape, and a forward-thinking
approach to education to create a one-of-a-kind learning environment.

[ Learn more about the Rock Ridge High School Project ][40]

## Transforming Rural Healthcare with Innovative Design for Smaller Communities

###### RIVERWOOD HEALTHCARE | MINNESOTA

At DSGW Architecture, we’re transforming rural healthcare with innovative design tailored to meet
the unique needs of smaller communities. Our recent work with Riverwood Healthcare Center brought
the **first Hybrid OR to a critical access hospital in Minnesota **— a game-changing addition that
expands surgical capabilities, reduces patient transfers, and enhances healthcare access close to
home.

This project goes beyond traditional design, bringing advanced medical technology and
patient-centered environments to rural settings. With features like the Hybrid OR, optimized patient
flow, and calming interiors, Riverwood represents the future of rural healthcare architecture.

Discover how we’re making a difference in rural healthcare and setting new standards in **Hybrid OR
design** for critical access hospitals.

[ Learn more about the Riverwood Healthcare Project ][41]

### MHA Nation Cultural Interpretive Center

Civic
DSGW has a culturally conceived engagement process that fosters two-way learning and discussion to
create our Indigenous designs. This results in lessons, imagery and concepts that are immersed in
culture and inform design decisions. Resiliency was key in bringing the MHA Interpretive Center to
life.
[More About This Project »][42]

We know that choosing the right pediatrician is an important decision for parents when considering
the health and well-being of their child. For this reason, our office is designed for individualized
pediatric care and services.

[Patient Centered Medical Home logo]
[Get in Touch][74]


We know that choosing the right pediatrician is an important decision for parents when considering
the health and well-being of their child. For this reason, our office is designed for individualized
pediatric care and services.

[Patient Centered Medical Home logo]
[Let's Talk][75]

## Our board-certified pediatricians make health care enjoyable for you and your little ones.

From your very first visit, we remain by your side throughout your child's treatment, providing
services unique to his or her needs. Put your child's care in the hands of a practice you can trust.
Contact East Lake Pediatrics in Palm Harbor and Trinity, FL.

##### [Meet Your Providers][76]

Learn about the doctors who will be providing expert care to your child.

##### [Patient Forms][77]

Find all the resources you need to get started on your child's treatment.

##### [Newborn Handbook][78]

Gain the guidance you need when it comes to caring for your newborn.

## New Patients

## Expecting Parents

## Insurance

## Resources

[East Lake Pediatrics Front Door]

### Treatment specialized to meet the needs of you and your child.

##### Doctors You Can Trust

Decades of combined experience and a comfortable, inviting atmosphere make your child's treatment a
breeze.

##### Friendly & Caring Staff

Our staff undergoes continual training to ensure that they are providing the best possible care for
your child.

[Patient Centered Medical Home logo]

# Your Preferred Pediatricians in Trinity, Palm Harbor, & Oldsmar

Our mission at East Lake Pediatrics is to provide outstanding pediatric care that is personalized to
the needs of our patients.

Our staff is committed to the health care of all of our patients. We enjoy working with children and
are well trained in healthy childhood growth and development as well as childhood illnesses.

We’re proud to announce that East Lake Pediatrics has been certified by the NCQA (National Committee
for Quality Assurance) as a Patient Centered Medical Home. This accreditation signifies that our
practice puts patients at the forefront of care, resulting in happier and healthier patients, as
well as better relationships between patients and their clinical care team. Each of these factors
have been proven to make for more efficient treatment and lower health care costs.

# Welcome to **Family Medical Center**

**Comprehensive Care for Every Stage of Life**

We are a primary care, patient-centered medical home (PCMH) serving your whole family with an
emphasis on proactive and preventive care.

[ Better Health Blog ][61]
[ Request an Appointment ][62]
[ Learn More ][63]
[ Better Health Blog ][64]
[ Request an Appointment ][65]
[ Learn More ][66]
[Entrance to a family medical center with glass doors and tan siding]

## Your Trusted **Primary Care Provider** in Lake Odessa, MI

At Family Medical Center, we provide compassionate primary care to patients of all ages. Whether
you're seeking routine checkups or more specific care, our team is dedicated to your wellness,
recovery, and long-term health.

## Patient Portal Login

Access your records, appointment details, and more with ease through our secure patient portal.

[ Login Now ][67]

## Healthcare Tailored to Your Family’s Needs

### GENERAL CARE


Routine check-ups, preventative care, and treatment for common illnesses and injuries across all
ages.

[ Read More ][68]

### INFANTS & CHILDREN


Pediatric care to support healthy growth and development, including vaccinations and wellness
checks.

[ Read More ][69]

### WOMEN'S HEALTH


Extensive care for women, including gynecological exams, family planning, and menopausal support.

[ Read More ][70]

### MEN'S HEALTH


Focused care for men’s health concerns, including screenings and preventative care.

[ Read More ][71]

### SENIOR CARE


Compassionate care for the unique needs of older adults, from chronic condition management to
wellness support.

[ Read More ][72]

### DISORDER ASSESSMENT


Professional evaluation and diagnosis of conditions affecting overall health and well-being.

[ Read More ][73]
[Office lobby of Family Medical Center in Lake Odessa, MI with a reception desk.]

## Why Choose **Family Medical Center?**

We’re committed to providing exceptional healthcare that meets the needs of your entire family.
Here’s what sets us apart:

**Experienced and compassionate staff.**

**Extensive, patient-centered care for all ages.**

**Warm and inviting office environment.**

**Emphasis on preventative care and education.**

**Convenient location in Lake Odessa.**

## Meet Our Providers

**Dr. CR Barnett**

**Primary Physician**

Dr. CR Barnett is a board-certified family physician with a medical degree from Indiana University.
He completed his residency at St. Vincent Hospital in 1984 and holds a Bachelor of Science from
Milligan College.

With decades of experience, Dr. Barnett is committed to building lasting relationships with his
patients. He works diligently to understand each patient’s unique medical history and health goals,
then empowers them to make informed decisions.

[ Learn More About Dr. Barnett ][74]
[A man wearing glasses and a black and white striped shirt]
[A woman wearing a black shirt and a necklace smiles for the camera]

**KC Wright**

**Nurse Practitioner**

KC Wright is a Nurse Practitioner and certified care manager. She holds a Master of Science in
Nursing from the University of Maryland, along with a Bachelor of Science from the University of
North Florida.


As a Nurse Practitioner, Wright offers comprehensive, patient-centered care, collaborating with Dr.
Barnett and other area medical specialists in their fields to facilitate thorough, seamless
treatment.

[ Learn More About KC Wright ][75]

## Patient Testimonials

“My family feels at home when we visit the Family Medical Center. The whole staff laughs, cries, and
supports my family with all of our medical needs. They treat their patients like their own family
and advocate for the best treatment."

### Keather Winslow

“Dr. Barnett and staff are all very professional but still provide a friendly atmosphere and an
abundance of smiles and laughter at Family Medical Center.”

### Rod and Marcia Lake

“I have trusted Dr. Barnett and his tremendous staff with the care of my six children for nearly 20
years. Even after moving to the Ann Arbor area eight years ago, the personalized, compassionate, and
exemplary hometown care that FMC has provided us is unmatched and well worth the 2-hour drive.”


### Nikki Sunstrum

"I have been coming here for many years now. Doctor Barnett is so easy to talk to and so kind takes
his time with me. The office staff are very friendly and make you feel good. I highly recommend him
as a Doctor."

### Alice

"I truly love and appreciate Dr. Barnett and his staff. My family and I have been patients for over
30 years, and would recommend them to anyone looking for a solid family practice."

### Cristi Brimmer

"I love Family Medical Center for myself and youngest son. Appointments are typically quick. KC
allows for parents to be involved in their child's medical care and creates a safe space for
discussion."

### Natosha Sage-EL Bylsma

For over 40 years, Family Medical Center has been a cornerstone of health and wellness in the Lake

primary care.

## Monthly Giveaway

Each month we have a drawing, and one lucky winner receives a $50 gift card to [**Buddy's On The
Beach**][83].

**How Can You Win?**

All you have to do is be a patient of ours and leave us a review on Google. Each month we will

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

## Built for the team, open to your agents

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

## **HEALTHARCH PROGRAM OPPORTUNITY**

**Patient Centered Medical Home Practice Transformation Recognition Technical Assistance**

The Florida Department of Health Children’s Medical Services (CMS) has partnered with HealthARCH on
its statewide initiative to assist eligible pediatric and family medicine practices with Patient
Centered Medical Home (PCMH) practice education and transformation. The PCMH model has become a
widely accepted standard with a variety of tools and processes that enable providers to more
effectively deliver better care and achieve improved outcomes.

For more detailed information on this Patient Centered Medical Home Transformation Recognition
program, please visit our program [page][32].

## The MIPS performance year started January 1st. Are you participating? We can help.** **

**Know Your Numbers – Get your estimated MIPS score!**

Are you taking advantage of MACRA by managing your performance and submitting annually to CMS?  The
HealthARCH consulting team can provide tailored services that maximize your score.  Our year long
compliance monitoring support will help keep your practice on track.  Call us today to find out
more.

Visit our [MACRA page][33] to learn more about the CMS Quality Payment Program (QPP), MIPS and APMs
and how you can position your practice for success in 2026 and beyond.



**SECURITY RISK ASSESSMENTS (SRA)**

The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Security Rule requires that covered
entities conduct a risk assessment of their healthcare organization. A risk assessment helps
healthcare organizations ensure they are compliant with HIPAA’s administrative, physical, and
technical safeguards. A risk assessment also helps reveal areas where protected health information
(PHI) could be at risk.

Our team of experts can assist you with your initial assessment and help you keep your
organization’s risk regularly updated to comply with HIPAA requirements.

[Click here][34] for our Privacy and Security services.

**E/M DOCUMENTATION AND CODING TRAINING**

Our certified trainers can prepare you and your practice to assess documentation according to
national guidelines, understand how to apply the rules, and ensure appropriate E/M category and
level assignment.  Our AHIMA-Approved trainers will provide you with the knowledge to fully document
the amount and complexity of the work performed to support the billed level of payment. We offer
in-depth training with hands-on coding examples and analysis so you will be fully prepared.  CME and
CEU credits are available for this training.

[Click here][35] for our E/M training services.

**PATIENT CENTERED MEDICAL HOME**

The Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) is a team-based coordinated approach to patient care. As
reimbursement models shift to quality rather than volume-based payments, the PCMH is becoming the
new standard for the future of healthcare delivery. Our experts can assist with PCMH recognition and
transformation services.

[Click here][36] for our PCMH services.

The ONC Regional Extension Center program ended in September 2016 and the UCF Regional Extension
Center rebranded as HealthARCH. Same mission, same staff of experienced consulting professionals and
same great service. Our focus is on you, the provider, and your continued success in the evolving
healthcare marketplace. We Are Your Healthcare Solutions Partner.


### Custom Consulting

We offer custom consulting services to fit your Health IT needs.

[Learn More][37]

## **HEALTHARCH PROGRAM OPPORTUNITY**

**Patient Centered Medical Home Practice Transformation Recognition Technical Assistance**

The Florida Department of Health Children’s Medical Services (CMS) has partnered with HealthARCH on
its statewide initiative to assist eligible pediatric and family medicine practices with Patient
Centered Medical Home (PCMH) practice education and transformation. The PCMH model has become a
widely accepted standard with a variety of tools and processes that enable providers to more
effectively deliver better care and achieve improved outcomes.

For more detailed information on this Patient Centered Medical Home Transformation Recognition
program, please visit our program [page][32].

## The MIPS performance year started January 1st. Are you participating? We can help.** **

**Know Your Numbers – Get your estimated MIPS score!**

Are you taking advantage of MACRA by managing your performance and submitting annually to CMS?  The
HealthARCH consulting team can provide tailored services that maximize your score.  Our year long
compliance monitoring support will help keep your practice on track.  Call us today to find out
more.

Visit our [MACRA page][33] to learn more about the CMS Quality Payment Program (QPP), MIPS and APMs
and how you can position your practice for success in 2026 and beyond.



**SECURITY RISK ASSESSMENTS (SRA)**

The Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Security Rule requires that covered
entities conduct a risk assessment of their healthcare organization. A risk assessment helps
healthcare organizations ensure they are compliant with HIPAA’s administrative, physical, and
technical safeguards. A risk assessment also helps reveal areas where protected health information
(PHI) could be at risk.

Our team of experts can assist you with your initial assessment and help you keep your
organization’s risk regularly updated to comply with HIPAA requirements.

[Click here][34] for our Privacy and Security services.

**E/M DOCUMENTATION AND CODING TRAINING**

Our certified trainers can prepare you and your practice to assess documentation according to
national guidelines, understand how to apply the rules, and ensure appropriate E/M category and
level assignment.  Our AHIMA-Approved trainers will provide you with the knowledge to fully document
the amount and complexity of the work performed to support the billed level of payment. We offer
in-depth training with hands-on coding examples and analysis so you will be fully prepared.  CME and
CEU credits are available for this training.

[Click here][35] for our E/M training services.

**PATIENT CENTERED MEDICAL HOME**

The Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH) is a team-based coordinated approach to patient care. As
reimbursement models shift to quality rather than volume-based payments, the PCMH is becoming the
new standard for the future of healthcare delivery. Our experts can assist with PCMH recognition and
transformation services.

[Click here][36] for our PCMH services.

The ONC Regional Extension Center program ended in September 2016 and the UCF Regional Extension
Center rebranded as HealthARCH. Same mission, same staff of experienced consulting professionals and
same great service. Our focus is on you, the provider, and your continued success in the evolving
healthcare marketplace. We Are Your Healthcare Solutions Partner.


### Custom Consulting

We offer custom consulting services to fit your Health IT needs.

[Learn More][37]

##### We Make A Promise To Our Patients To Care For Them In A

### “Medical House”

###### [ Facility that supports patient-centered care][18]

Our company recognizes that a visit in a health care facility can be stressful for people. We
believe that all people should receive their health care in a facility that is modern, pleasing to
the patient, effective and efficient to offer you state of the art medical care. We have worked with
designers who specialize in health care facilities to provide you with a primary health care journey
that you will benefit from and appreciate.

###### [ Open Seven Days a week ][19]

We know that your health care needs are not only during the usual time of office hours. Health care
is needed at any time of the day and night. Saudi Health Power is always available to you. We prefer
that you contact us if you have an urgent problem. If our Family medicine Centers are open, we will
see you for an appointment or you can walk in to see a doctor. We keep our Family Medicine Centers
open seven days a week and with extended hours.

###### [ Your personal care team ][20]

Saudi Health Power has created the SHP Care Model© which is to serve as, a “Medical Home” where you
can come for most of your health care needs. We have studied many countries and have found that
primary care being delivered by a team of health care providers can reduce your need for
hospitalizations; reduce your costs of care, increase the quality of your care and increase your
satisfaction.

###### [ Develop Relationship with Patient and Family][21]

Saudi Health Power has designed a new approach to the delivery of primary care in Saudi Arabia, the
SHP Family Care Model©. This is “Medical Home” for you. This is not simply a place but rather the
organization of primary care delivered with the patients’ needs at the core.

###### [ Engage, Educate, Inform Patients & Staff][22]

The SHP Care Model© will provide health care for all patients, of all ages from preconception –
through pregnancy and post conception care, to wellness and preventive care, acute and chronic
illness, urgent care and when needed referral through specific pathways to the necessary specialist
or hospital. It will also provide in office procedures or working with specialists for
hospital-based procedures. As well, SHP will remain engaged with its patients through their end of
life care.

###### [ Quality Care, Evidence Based Guidelines][23]

The SHP Care Model © is best described as a model or philosophy of primary care that is
patient-centered, comprehensive, team-based, coordinated, accessible, and focused on quality and
safety. It has been developed from a widely accepted model for how primary care should be organized
and delivered throughout the health care system and is a philosophy of health care delivery that
encourages providers and care teams to meet patients where they are, from the simplest to the most
complex conditions

###### [ Predict Health Risk of Individuals,Populations][24]

Achieving and maintaining good health as individuals and as families is our goal. We also feel that
it is important that we can offer you some predictions, based on the science that we know, on how
your health outcomes could be. Our partnership with the specialized health technology tool developer
TPP -UK, has given us access to information and artificial intelligence tools to help us give you
advice about your health.

###### [ Measure and Evaluate Team Performance and Patient Outcomes][25]

Saudi Health Power takes its responsibility to you and all of our patients to ensure that your
doctor and care team are providing you with the highest quality of care. We do this through constant
evaluation of their work. Our medical leaders review patient records. We also have developed a
system of reports with our partner TPP - UK that allows us to measure how well our doctors are
performing in the care of their patients. There are international standards for the care of many
types of disease as well as for preventing disease.

###### [ Balanced Work/Home Life of Physicians & others in Care Team][26]

Saudi Health Power believes that your Family Doctor and the primary health care team must work
together to remain available to you in your times of need. These health care professionals support
each other, and the company supports them to remain healthy themselves and supports their families
in the balance of time at work and tome at home.

###### [ Technology that Supports Communication & Exchange of Info.][27]

To achieve its goal of providing comprehensive health care including chronic care, acute care,
wellness benefits and population health, HPM has developed a strategic relationship with a
significant health care technology company.

### FAMILY HEALTH INSURANCE CARD

Are you suffering from health problems? Is it difficult to choose a doctor to treat you? Are you
looking for a primary health care center to take care of your family’s health? We have a solution
for you through a membership of a Family Health Card. Insurance card that offers you an access to
medical services in more than 350 hospitals and medical centers. In addition to the recent medical
techniques and international quality standards which you will benefit from in Health Power Clinics.
Health Power Clinics offer you complete primary and preventive services through an efficient family
physician who is competent in providing medical needs to save your family members health.

Getting an insurance card will allow you to benefit from various medical services such as:
* Family clinics
* Dental clinics
* Primary surgical procedures
* Laboratories with barcode systems
* Physiotherapy
* Home medical care
* Training courses in health and nutrition
* Health program specialized in physical fitness and nutrition
* Transportation means suitable for patients
* Pharmacy
* Coffee shop

Saudi Health Power is pleased that you have chosen our team to provide healthcare for you and your
family. Our health care teams are led by Family Medicine Consultants and include doctors who we have
trained to provide only the highest quality of care.
