##### We Make A Promise To Our Patients To Care For Them In A

### “Medical House”

###### [ Facility that supports patient-centered care][18]

Our company recognizes that a visit in a health care facility can be stressful for people. We
believe that all people should receive their health care in a facility that is modern, pleasing to
the patient, effective and efficient to offer you state of the art medical care. We have worked with
designers who specialize in health care facilities to provide you with a primary health care journey
that you will benefit from and appreciate.

###### [ Open Seven Days a week ][19]

We know that your health care needs are not only during the usual time of office hours. Health care
is needed at any time of the day and night. Saudi Health Power is always available to you. We prefer
that you contact us if you have an urgent problem. If our Family medicine Centers are open, we will
see you for an appointment or you can walk in to see a doctor. We keep our Family Medicine Centers
open seven days a week and with extended hours.

###### [ Your personal care team ][20]

Saudi Health Power has created the SHP Care Model© which is to serve as, a “Medical Home” where you
can come for most of your health care needs. We have studied many countries and have found that
primary care being delivered by a team of health care providers can reduce your need for
hospitalizations; reduce your costs of care, increase the quality of your care and increase your
satisfaction.

###### [ Develop Relationship with Patient and Family][21]

Saudi Health Power has designed a new approach to the delivery of primary care in Saudi Arabia, the
SHP Family Care Model©. This is “Medical Home” for you. This is not simply a place but rather the
organization of primary care delivered with the patients’ needs at the core.

###### [ Engage, Educate, Inform Patients & Staff][22]

The SHP Care Model© will provide health care for all patients, of all ages from preconception –
through pregnancy and post conception care, to wellness and preventive care, acute and chronic
illness, urgent care and when needed referral through specific pathways to the necessary specialist
or hospital. It will also provide in office procedures or working with specialists for
hospital-based procedures. As well, SHP will remain engaged with its patients through their end of
life care.

###### [ Quality Care, Evidence Based Guidelines][23]

The SHP Care Model © is best described as a model or philosophy of primary care that is
patient-centered, comprehensive, team-based, coordinated, accessible, and focused on quality and
safety. It has been developed from a widely accepted model for how primary care should be organized
and delivered throughout the health care system and is a philosophy of health care delivery that
encourages providers and care teams to meet patients where they are, from the simplest to the most
complex conditions

###### [ Predict Health Risk of Individuals,Populations][24]

Achieving and maintaining good health as individuals and as families is our goal. We also feel that
it is important that we can offer you some predictions, based on the science that we know, on how
your health outcomes could be. Our partnership with the specialized health technology tool developer
TPP -UK, has given us access to information and artificial intelligence tools to help us give you
advice about your health.

###### [ Measure and Evaluate Team Performance and Patient Outcomes][25]

Saudi Health Power takes its responsibility to you and all of our patients to ensure that your
doctor and care team are providing you with the highest quality of care. We do this through constant
evaluation of their work. Our medical leaders review patient records. We also have developed a
system of reports with our partner TPP - UK that allows us to measure how well our doctors are
performing in the care of their patients. There are international standards for the care of many
types of disease as well as for preventing disease.

###### [ Balanced Work/Home Life of Physicians & others in Care Team][26]

Saudi Health Power believes that your Family Doctor and the primary health care team must work
together to remain available to you in your times of need. These health care professionals support
each other, and the company supports them to remain healthy themselves and supports their families
in the balance of time at work and tome at home.

###### [ Technology that Supports Communication & Exchange of Info.][27]

To achieve its goal of providing comprehensive health care including chronic care, acute care,
wellness benefits and population health, HPM has developed a strategic relationship with a
significant health care technology company.

### FAMILY HEALTH INSURANCE CARD

Are you suffering from health problems? Is it difficult to choose a doctor to treat you? Are you
looking for a primary health care center to take care of your family’s health? We have a solution
for you through a membership of a Family Health Card. Insurance card that offers you an access to
medical services in more than 350 hospitals and medical centers. In addition to the recent medical
techniques and international quality standards which you will benefit from in Health Power Clinics.
Health Power Clinics offer you complete primary and preventive services through an efficient family
physician who is competent in providing medical needs to save your family members health.

Getting an insurance card will allow you to benefit from various medical services such as:
* Family clinics
* Dental clinics
* Primary surgical procedures
* Laboratories with barcode systems
* Physiotherapy
* Home medical care
* Training courses in health and nutrition
* Health program specialized in physical fitness and nutrition
* Transportation means suitable for patients
* Pharmacy
* Coffee shop

Saudi Health Power is pleased that you have chosen our team to provide healthcare for you and your
family. Our health care teams are led by Family Medicine Consultants and include doctors who we have
trained to provide only the highest quality of care.

### Caring for our community one patient at a time.

HHC is a Federally Qualified Health Center, in central rural Maine, that offers medical services,
dental services, behavioral health services, a sliding-fee scale for payment that is based on what

## Your Community Health Partner

For more than 30 years, we’ve provided high-quality health care to individuals and families –
regardless of insurance status or ability to pay.

## Trusted Care

We are committed to providing high-quality, patient-centered care you can trust.

[Star]

### Quality You Can Trust

As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and FTCA Deemed Facility, HPC meets rigorous standards
for quality, safety and patient-centered care.

[Learn More][52]

### Care for All

We serve everyone regardless of insurance status or ability to pay with our Sliding Fee Discount
Program.

[Learn More][53]

### Here for You

From prevention to treatment, we’re here to support you and your family at every stage.

[Learn More][54]

Local care from providers who understand your community and are committed to your wellbeing.

## Health Partnership Clinic

Health Partnership Clinic would like to be your medical home. We partner with you to manage your
medical, dental and behavioral health. You are welcome here at any age, with or without insurance.

We speak Spanish and other languages. You can access our services at our clinic sites – [Olathe,
Shawnee Mission, Ottawa and Paola][57].

“The entire community is a much better place, and our future is brighter thanks to Health

need to get the word out about it. There are so many people in the community who need what Health
Partnership has to offer.”

“Dr. Haider is amazing. For everybody to take note of the little things is why we come here. And
it’s just amazing.”

“HPC was here when we needed them. They really helped us get started on the right foot.”

“I was a walking tornado when I walked in there. And they jumped right in to find a diagnosis and

“I was able to qualify for the clinic’s sliding fee program—which made dental care more affordable

* ## Affordable, Accessible, High-Quality Care for All.
  
  Health care for children, adults and families throughout our community – regardless of insurance
  status or ability to pay.
  
  [Schedule an Appointment][51]

## Your Community Health Partner

For more than 30 years, we’ve provided high-quality health care to individuals and families –
regardless of insurance status or ability to pay.

[Users]
**11,000+**

Patients Served Annually

[Calendar]
**21,000+**

Patient Visits Each Year

**30+**

Years of Service to Our Community

## Trusted Care

We are committed to providing high-quality, patient-centered care you can trust.

[Star]

### Quality You Can Trust

As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) and FTCA Deemed Facility, HPC meets rigorous standards
for quality, safety and patient-centered care.

[Learn More][52]

### Care for All

We serve everyone regardless of insurance status or ability to pay with our Sliding Fee Discount
Program.

[Learn More][53]

### Here for You

From prevention to treatment, we’re here to support you and your family at every stage.

[Learn More][54]
[Renren]

### Rooted in Community

Local care from providers who understand your community and are committed to your wellbeing.

### TELEHEALTH NOW AVAILABLE
### Call 913-648-2266 to schedule an appointment.

[Learn More About Telehealth][55]

### THE BEST PREVENTION
### IS EARLY DETECTION.

[Learn More About Mammograms][56]

## Health Partnership Clinic

Health Partnership Clinic would like to be your medical home. We partner with you to manage your
medical, dental and behavioral health. You are welcome here at any age, with or without insurance.

We speak Spanish and other languages. You can access our services at our clinic sites – [Olathe,
Shawnee Mission, Ottawa and Paola][57].

## Making a Difference

“The staff are friendly and competent. They make you feel like you’re family – like you’re home.”

**Patient Carolyn, Shawnee, Kan.**

“The entire community is a much better place, and our future is brighter thanks to Health
Partnership.”

**Joy Boan, MSEd, BSN, RN, School Nurse, Fairview Elementary School, Olathe School District**

“It’s a small place, where you can get the same quality of care you would anywhere else. We just
need to get the word out about it. There are so many people in the community who need what Health
Partnership has to offer.”

**Patient Carolyn, Shawnee, Kan.**

“Dr. Haider is amazing. For everybody to take note of the little things is why we come here. And
it’s just amazing.”

**Parent Derek, Shawnee, Kan.**

“HPC was here when we needed them. They really helped us get started on the right foot.”

**Parent Dave, Overland Park, Kan.**

“I was a walking tornado when I walked in there. And they jumped right in to find a diagnosis and
find the right medicines that could help me. I am doing a lot better now.”

**Patient Mike, Spring Hill, Kan.**

“I was able to qualify for the clinic’s sliding fee program—which made dental care more affordable
for my two children.”

**Patient and HPC Staff Member Stephanie, Olathe, Kan.**

“Health Partnership Clinic provides medical, behavioral and dental health care to many students and
families in the Shawnee Mission School District.  Walk in clinic availability and on site
comprehensive dental care make it easy to get our students the care they need.”

**Shelby Rebeck, MSN, BSN, RN, Health Services Coordinator, Shawnee Mission School District**

“My care at Health Partnership Clinic has been the best I’ve ever had. Dr. Miller is very caring and
understanding and tries her best to get the best care for her patients.”

**Patient Aimee, Ottawa, Kan.**

“My family and I have been trusting our health care to HPC for about 6 years and I wouldn’t have it
any other way. The staff is beyond knowledgeable in their field, and they never fail to make sure
that we are satisfied before we leave the office. I just can’t say enough about this amazing team!”

**Patient Alaina, Paola, Kan.**

**FTCA Deemed Facility**

Health Partnership Clinic is a FTCA deemed facility, a Health Center Program grantee under 42 U.S.C.
254b and a deemed Public Health Service employee under 42 U.S.C. 233(g)-(n). This health center
receives funding from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and has Federal Public
Health Service deemed status with respect to certain health or health-related claims, including
medical malpractice claims, for itself and its covered individuals.

# Medical Home

[Home][139]  /  [Practice Management][140]  /  Medical Home

A medical home is an approach to providing comprehensive primary care that facilitates partnerships
between patients, clinicians, medical staff, and families. A medical home extends beyond the four
walls of a clinical practice. It includes specialty care, educational services, family support and
more.

## 
## Professional Resources

[

### For Families and Caregivers

Discover information that will assist families in successfully partnering with their child’s medical
home.

][141]
[

### Tools and Resources for Medical Home Implementation

Practical tools and resources to assist families, practices and others with pediatric medical home
implementation and related efforts to enhance collaboration between professionals and families.

][142]
[

### What is Medical Home?

A definition of the medical home model, a history of the medical home and resources to help explain
the medical home care model.

][143]

### "Every child and youth deserves a medical home."

**Calvin CJ Sia, MD, FAAP**
Pediatrician
Honolulu, HI

*

# Medical Home

[Home][139]  /  [Practice Management][140]  /  Medical Home

A medical home is an approach to providing comprehensive primary care that facilitates partnerships
between patients, clinicians, medical staff, and families. A medical home extends beyond the four
walls of a clinical practice. It includes specialty care, educational services, family support and
more.

## 
## Professional Resources

[

### For Families and Caregivers

Discover information that will assist families in successfully partnering with their child’s medical
home.

][141]
[

### Tools and Resources for Medical Home Implementation

Practical tools and resources to assist families, practices and others with pediatric medical home
implementation and related efforts to enhance collaboration between professionals and families.

][142]
[

### What is Medical Home?

A definition of the medical home model, a history of the medical home and resources to help explain
the medical home care model.

][143]

### "Every child and youth deserves a medical home."

**Calvin CJ Sia, MD, FAAP**
Pediatrician
Honolulu, HI

# Most Trusted Pediatrician in Muskegon

## Same-day appointments, compassionate care, and long-term support from birth to graduation.

[Schedule an Appointment][6]
[New Patient Info][7]

### Same-Day Care

Quick appointments when your child needs care most

### Now Accepting New Patients

Welcoming new families to our pediatric practice

### Most Insurance Including Medicaid

Accepting most major insurance plans for your convenience

## Meet Our Caring Pediatricians

Kelli R. Lund, MD and Jennifer King, MD bring decades of combined experience in pediatric care to
families throughout Muskegon. They are board-certified pediatricians dedicated to providing
compassionate, comprehensive care for your children from birth through adolescence.

**Dr. Lund:** 25+ years of experience specializing in comprehensive pediatric care, asthma
management, and pediatric mental health

**Dr. King:** Practicing since 2012, specializing in general pediatrics, newborn care, and
family-centered healthcare

[Meet Our Doctors][8][Schedule an Appointment][9]
[Dr. Kelli Lund and Dr. Jennifer King - Pediatricians at Muskegon Pediatrics]

Currently Accepting New Patients

## Comprehensive Pediatric Care

From prenatal consultations to graduation day, we provide complete healthcare services for every
stage of your child's development.

[

### Same Day Sick Visits

][10][

### 24/7 On-Call Access

][11][

### Well-Child Exams

][12][

### Adolecent Care

][13][

### Prenatal Consultation

][14][

### Breastfeeding Support

][15][

### Immunizations

][16][

### Vaccines

][17][

### Care Management

][18][

### Mental Health

][19][

### Sports Physicals

][20]
[View All Services][21]

## What Families Say

Hear from the families who trust us with their children's health and well-being.

> "As a first time mom, I had many questions (and fears) when it came to the health of my son. Dr.
> King always answered my concerns promptly, and with patience, kindness, and knowledge. I value her
> expertise and recommend her to everyone."

— Happy Parent

> "Dr. King has been my child's doctor since the day she was born. I have had nothing but positive
> experiences and would highly suggest her to anyone looking. She explains things in a way everyone
> can understand and she is full of helpful tips and tricks, and as a new mother she was exactly
> what we needed and more. Plus my kid really likes her so that's always a bonus!!"

— Grateful Mom

> "Dr. King is great for our family. The kids relate well to her. We find Dr. King to be a Mom and a
> Doctor! Loving nature. Caring, positive, she takes extra time when needed. We as a family are
> blessed! Happy to have this Doctor in our lives! May God continue to bless Dr. King and her own
> family!! Thank you for all your care, help, guidance, wisdom and laughter too!"

— The LaBelle Family

> "The whole team does a fantastic job here! They are all so positive, kind, and helpful. We always
> get personalized care and the team clearly goes above and beyond what would be a 'typical'
> experience at a doctors office."

— Satisfied Family

> "If I could rate Dr. King higher, I would. She is absolutely amazing. She is so comforting,
> realistic, honest and personable. Never bothered with my million worried mama questions. Biggest
> thanks to her 💛"

— Thankful Mama

> "Dr. King has been with all 3 of my children from day 1! There is no other medical professional
> that I would trust more with my kids. She has always gone above and beyond and continues to do
> so!"

— Loyal Parent

#### [Learning from the history of nursing][151]

Perhaps the most consistent thread throughout nursing history is the commitment to caring for
individuals during times of illness, injury, suffering, and vulnerability. From informal caregiving
in families and religious communities to modern professional nursing practice, compassion remains
central. Historical examples: nurses serving soldiers during war and early public health nurses
caring for impoverished populations. Contemporary relevance: patient-centered care, compassionate
communication, and holistic health and healing.

[][152]

#### [The pursuit of equity in nurse staffing and AI][153]

For decades, nurse staffing has been a source of nursing dissatisfaction. It continues to be at the
crux of many pervasive issues that impact the sustainability and strength of our profession. There
are two opposing views: one narrative describes a shortage of nurses while the other argues a
sufficient number of nurses but not enough who are willing to work in current healthcare conditions.

###### Trusted Expertise

Our board-certified providers bring decades of combined experience and up to date pediatric guidance
so your family receives safe, thorough care.

###### Here When You Need Us

We offer extended weekday hours and Saturday appointments to fit your family’s busy schedule. After
hours advice is available for urgent matters

###### We Listen, We Care

We take time with every family, listening first to ensure you and your child receive personalized,
thoughtful care.

[Northpointe Pediatrics team of pediatricians and nurse practitioners in Warren, Michigan]

# Caring for Children in Metro Detroit for Over 30 Years

For more than thirty years, families have trusted Northpointe Pediatrics to provide high quality
pediatric care from infancy through young adulthood.

 

As a designated Patient Centered Medical Home (PCMH), we focus on building strong, trusting
relationships with every family.

 

Clear communication is central to our approach, and we are here to support your family every step of
the way.

[Learn More][21]

New patient? Call our office at [586-558-2111][22]

[Book an Appointment Online][23]

# After Hours Care

 If your child’s illness or injury is life threatening call 911.


Otherwise for urgent matters that cannot wait until business hours call [(586) 558-2111][24] to be
connected for further medical advice.

[After Hours Info ][25]

At Northpointe Pediatrics, we combine expert medical knowledge with a warm, personal approach.  We

visit is focused on understanding your child’s needs and supporting you with thoughtful, evidence
based guidance.

* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something

  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from

  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.

  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After

  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.

  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to
  a PowerPoint.

  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or

  makes content more engaging and memorable.

  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a

  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.
* ### Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?
  
  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.
* ### Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?
  
  Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine,
  and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations
  consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,

## Frequently asked questions
* ### Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?
  
  Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something
  dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you
  convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or
  Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.
* ### What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?
  
  Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from
  a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested
  slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.
* ### How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?
  
  Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After
  entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a
  complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make
  final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.
* ### Can Prezi create a PowerPoint (PPT) with AI?
  
  Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your
  presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to
  a PowerPoint.
* ### Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or
  upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and
  visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design
  before presenting.
* ###  Is Prezi a free AI presentation tool?
  
  Yes, Prezi is available as a free presentation software with AI-powered features included. If you
  want unlimited access to Prezi AI, you can try a free trial or upgrade to a paid subscription. No
  matter which subscription you choose, you will be able to present with Prezi's unique format that
  makes content more engaging and memorable.
* ### How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?
  
  While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a
  smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom
  design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your
  content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.
* ### What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?
  
  With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including
  pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation
  with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.
* ### Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?
  
  Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical
  flow and creating a consistent design.
* ### Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?
  
  Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange
  slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.
* ### Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?
  
  Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine,
  and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations
  consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,
  [Prezi for Teams][24] is an ideal solution.
* ### What should I include in a prompt for the best AI presentation results?
  
  For the best results, include your audience, goal, topic, tone, and any must-have points. Example:

  explore our [AI prompt library][25] to get inspired.

# Find the right senior living community - *without the runaround.*

Compare assisted living, memory care, independent living, and skilled nursing communities across all
50 states. Real reviews and real monthly prices, free to browse — with everything you need to
connect with a community when you’re ready.

Search

Covering communities in every U.S. state · Pricing shown up front · Always free

Start here

## What kind of care are you looking for?

Most families start without knowing the terminology. Here’s what each level of care actually means,
in plain language.

[

### Independent Living

For active, self-sufficient seniors

Apartment-style living with dining, activities, and maintenance handled - no personal care needed.

Browse communities → ][7] [

### Assisted Living

For help with daily tasks

Support with bathing, dressing, meals, and medications while keeping as much independence as
possible.

Browse communities → ][8] [

### Memory Care

For Alzheimer’s & dementia

Secured communities with trained staff and structured routines designed for cognitive conditions.

Browse communities → ][9] [

### Skilled Nursing

For 24/7 medical care

Round-the-clock nursing for complex medical needs, rehabilitation, or recovery after a hospital

Good to know

## Common questions from families

What’s the difference between assisted living and memory care?

Assisted living supports daily tasks like bathing, medication, and meals while residents keep their
independence. Memory care adds secured environments, specially trained staff, and structured
routines designed for people living with Alzheimer’s or other dementias.

How much does senior living cost?

Costs vary widely by care type and region. Independent living is generally the least expensive,
followed by assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing. We show real monthly price ranges on
every community page so you can compare options in your area.

When is it time to consider memory care?

Common signs include wandering, safety concerns at home, caregiver burnout, and needs that exceed
what assisted living can provide. A physician or geriatric care manager can help you evaluate the
right level of care.

Is Seniors.FYI free to use?

Yes. Browsing communities, reviews, and pricing information on Seniors.FYI is completely free — no
account required.

## Common questions from families

What’s the difference between assisted living and memory care?

Assisted living supports daily tasks like bathing, medication, and meals while residents keep their
independence. Memory care adds secured environments, specially trained staff, and structured
routines designed for people living with Alzheimer’s or other dementias.

How much does senior living cost?

Costs vary widely by care type and region. Independent living is generally the least expensive,
followed by assisted living, memory care, and skilled nursing. We show real monthly price ranges on
every community page so you can compare options in your area.

When is it time to consider memory care?

Common signs include wandering, safety concerns at home, caregiver burnout, and needs that exceed
what assisted living can provide. A physician or geriatric care manager can help you evaluate the
right level of care.

Is Seniors.FYI free to use?

Yes. Browsing communities, reviews, and pricing information on Seniors.FYI is completely free — no
account required.

#### Robert Stall MD
#### Founder and CEO
#### [Stall Senior Medical LLC][7]
#### [OldSmarts® University][8]

#### Dr. Stall is a fellowship trained geriatrician and MIT engineering graduate who is dedicated to
#### the care of older adults and helping their loved ones.  He has over 35 years experience working
#### in the geriatric continuum of care, serving in the capacity of medical director, consultant,
#### and attending physician for hospitals, home care agencies, and senior living facilities.

## Patient Advice Request

Click [HERE][9] to schedule an advice call for yourself or someone else

Feedback/insights/guidance especially for:
Older adults and family caregivers

**Common issues:**
Care needs increased / overwhelming
Caregiving needs increased/overwhelming
Driving concerns
Frequent falls or afraid of falling
Gradual decline in health status
Inadequate control of symptoms / health problems
Intolerable pain
New / worsening memory problem
Poor quality of life
Possible medication side effect / too many medications
Sudden decline in health status
Unsafe living situation

## Business Consultations

Click [HERE][10] to book an appointment

Feedback/insights/guidance especially for:
Senior-care startups and existing businesses

**Common issues:**
Addressing cognitive and other health issues in older employees
Age-friendly staff training
Decreasing expenses
Improving customer retention
Improving products & services
Legal case review
Lowering health insurance costs
Minimizing absenteeism for family caregivers
New customer acquisition
Reducing liability
Strategic planning in an aging world
Strengthening brand

# BUILT FOR COMMERCIAL

engineered for scale

Commercial biologics manufacturing demands infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational
precision. Bora Biologics offers a bi‑coastal, inspection‑proven U.S. biologics platform designed
for commercialization from day one. Our integrated drug substance operations in San Diego, CA and
Rockville, MD, supported by a development center of excellence in Zhubei, Taiwan, provide the
foundation for reliable scale and licensed supply.

Together, our platform supports partners from development through commercial production — delivering
the execution discipline required for durable commercial performance.

 **20,000L **U.S. single-use bioreactor capacity
 **3 **active commercial programs supplying **6 ** global markets
  **200+ **GMP batches executed
**100% ** first-pass PPQ success
**2 ** FDA-registered facilities specialized in late-stage production
**1 ** integrated early-stage development center of excellence

[ EXPLORE how we do it ][43]

# Advancing Biologics

one cell at a time

A technology-driven Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), Bora Biologics
specializes in mammalian and microbial development and manufacturing. Our mission is to accelerate
access to cutting-edge technologies and comprehensive manufacturing capabilities that empower our
clients to transform the future of medicine. **With a focus on collaboration, we are dedicated to
advancing biologics one cell at a time.**

[image description] [image description] [image description] [image description]

tailored to you

We adapt seamlessly to your needs, ensuring efficiency and cost savings at every stage of
development and manufacturing. **Your success is our priority.**

multidisciplinary approach and a focus on innovation, our team delivers customized solutions that
drive efficiency, quality, and accelerated time-to-market for biologics offerings.
* Cell line development
* High throughput media screening and optimization
* Mammalian cell culture development
* Microbial fermentation development
* High throughput resin screening and chromatography development
* Filtration process development (depth, sterile, viral, TFF)
* Inclusion body recovery and protein refold
* Conjugation and pegylation process optimization
* Technology transfer and scale up
* Viral clearance study design and support
* Process characterization

from concept to commercialization.

TAIWAN
Hsinchu Biomedical Science Park, Zhubei City, Taiwan

Located in one of Taiwan’s fastest growing biomedical clusters, our Zhubei facility serves as Bora
Biologics’ integrated development center of excellence. The cGMP site is built on scalable
single‑use platform technology, advancing programs from early development through clinical supply to
enable seamless transition to U.S. commercial manufacturing.EXPLORE

### Bora Biologics

Zhubei City, Taiwan

On the forefront of the newest technologies, this facility features single-use technology for your
mammalian and microbial early-stage programs:
* 100+ cGMP batches with 100% success rate continuously since 2014
* 48,000 sf of GMP and R&D space

* FIH Clinical Drug Substance Manufacturing: Mammalian and microbial production supporting Phase I
  and early Phase II programs.
* Process Development & IND-Enabling Support: Platform-based upstream and downstream optimization to
  support regulatory filings.
* Analytical & Release Testing: In-house testing capabilities supporting batch release, stability,
  and comparability.
* Global Tech Transfer Pathway: Designed to enable seamless progression to San Diego and Rockville
  facilities for late-stage and commercial supply.

Accelerating molecules from development to First‑in‑Human
* Cell Line Development: Generation of high‑performing, stable cell lines designed to support robust
  process development and clinical manufacturing.
* Process & Analytical Development (DS & DP): Integrated upstream, downstream, and formulation
  development to establish scalable, regulatory‑ready processes for drug substance and drug product.
* Analytical & Bioassay Development: Method development, qualification, and validation to support
  IND submissions, product characterization, and comparability assessments.
* QC Microbiology & Release Support: Dedicated microbiology and GMP testing teams ensuring compliant
  release and environmental monitoring for clinical supply.

East Coast Biotech Corridor, Rockville, MD, USA

with inspection‑proven infrastructure.EXPLORE

Rockville, MD

technology and integrated quality systems, Rockville supports scalable commercial supply for global
markets.

* 11,000L installed commercial capacity
* 100% single-use drug substance manufacturing

* Automated TFF systems

# BUILT FOR COMMERCIAL

engineered for scale

Commercial biologics manufacturing demands infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational
precision. Bora Biologics offers a bi‑coastal, inspection‑proven U.S. biologics platform designed
for commercialization from day one. Our integrated drug substance operations in San Diego, CA and
Rockville, MD, supported by a development center of excellence in Zhubei, Taiwan, provide the
foundation for reliable scale and licensed supply.

Together, our platform supports partners from development through commercial production — delivering
the execution discipline required for durable commercial performance.

 **20,000L **U.S. single-use bioreactor capacity
 **3 **active commercial programs supplying **6 ** global markets
  **200+ **GMP batches executed
**100% ** first-pass PPQ success
**2 ** FDA-registered facilities specialized in late-stage production
**1 ** integrated early-stage development center of excellence

[ EXPLORE how we do it ][43]

# Advancing Biologics

one cell at a time

A technology-driven Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), Bora Biologics
specializes in mammalian and microbial development and manufacturing. Our mission is to accelerate
access to cutting-edge technologies and comprehensive manufacturing capabilities that empower our
clients to transform the future of medicine. **With a focus on collaboration, we are dedicated to
advancing biologics one cell at a time.**

[image description] [image description] [image description] [image description]

# End-to-End CDMO Solutions

tailored to you

We adapt seamlessly to your needs, ensuring efficiency and cost savings at every stage of
development and manufacturing. **Your success is our priority.**

## clinical to commercial scale

mammalian & microbial expertise

DEVELOPMENT PROCESSES
Process Development
[image description] [image description]

### process development

mammalian & microbial

Bora Biologics stands at the forefront of mammalian and microbial process development, excelling in
the design, optimization, and scale-up of biopharmaceutical production processes. With a
multidisciplinary approach and a focus on innovation, our team delivers customized solutions that
drive efficiency, quality, and accelerated time-to-market for biologics offerings.
* Cell line development
* High throughput media screening and optimization
* Mammalian cell culture development
* Microbial fermentation development
* High throughput resin screening and chromatography development
* Filtration process development (depth, sterile, viral, TFF)
* Inclusion body recovery and protein refold
* Conjugation and pegylation process optimization
* Technology transfer and scale up
* Viral clearance study design and support
* Process characterization

[ EXPLORE Our Systems ][44]

mammalian & microbial

bring products to market faster and more cost-effectively.
* Allosteric FD Platform
* Biophysical HT Platform
* Analytical Platform
* Customized Formulations
* Stability Studies

### GMP MANUFACTURING

mammalian & microbial

Bora Biologics offers full-service GMP manufacturing resources and capacity to expedite your
mammalian and microbial projects. With a proven track record spanning preclinical to Investigational
New Drug (IND) applications to Biologics License Applications (BLA) to commercialization, and a U.S.
FDA and Health Canada approved biosimilar, our experience makes us a reliable partner.
* FDA Registered Facility in San Diego, CA, USA
* FDA Registered Facility in Rockville, MD, USA
* TFDA Registered Facility in Zhubei City, Taiwan
* Clinical and Commercial Production
* Multiple GMP Manufacturing Suites
* 24+ Single-Use Bioreactors (SUBs)
* 8+ Stainless Steel Fermentors
* >200,000sf GMP and R&D space
* Temperature-controlled GMP warehouses

[ EXPLORE OUR MANUFACTURING CAPABILITIES ][47]
Quality Control & Assurance
[image description] [image description]

### QUALITY CONTROL & ASSURANCE

exceeding regulatory benchmarks

Quality is a non-negotiable at Bora Biologics. Our mature quality management system employs rigorous
testing protocols, ensuring the safety, identity, strength, and purity of every product. With
meticulous testing, validation, and monitoring, we ensure your product meets or exceeds regulatory
benchmarks.
* QC Testing / Validation / Monitoring
* QA Systems / Operations / Engineering
* End-to-End Regulatory Support

[ DISCOVER OUR ROBUST QMS ][48]

supporting the backbone of every project

Bora Biologics believes a robust supply chain is the backbone of every successful biopharmaceutical
program. We have successfully navigated the path from concept to market and share our experience and
know-how to keep your projects on track.
* GMP Warehousing
* Vendor Management
* Inventory Management
* Packaging / Shipping / Fulfillment

ensuring your vision is realized

At Bora Biologics, your success is our success. Our timeline driven collaborative approach ensures

# State-of-the-Art Facilities

from concept to commercialization

We leverage our state-of-the-art facilities and global presence to efficiently move your project
from concept to commercialization.

TAIWAN
Hsinchu Biomedical Science Park, Zhubei City, Taiwan

Located in one of Taiwan’s fastest growing biomedical clusters, our Zhubei facility serves as Bora
Biologics’ integrated development center of excellence. The cGMP site is built on scalable
single‑use platform technology, advancing programs from early development through clinical supply to
enable seamless transition to U.S. commercial manufacturing.EXPLORE

## Welcome to
## Tuba City Regional Health Care Corporation

Tuba City Regional Health Care is dedicated to providing the community and patients with the highest
level of health care in Northern Arizona. We are proud to be part of this community and
organization. Together we care for each other.

#### **“*Our Mission is to provide safe, accessible, quality, and culturally sensitive
#### healthcare.*”**

### With Us, It's Always Personal

Our providers and professional staff take pride and honor the dignity in all individuals. Our
mission is to provide safe, accessible, quality, and culturally sensitive healthcare.

### The Highest Quality Healthcare

Laboratory, and Primary Care Medical Home certification, including a 2-Star rating (3-Star in 2021)
by CMS

### Improving The Quality of Your Life

We make it easier to access medical care at the community level through our three satellite
facilities (Flagstaff, Page, Bodaway) and a mobile medical van that drives out to remote
communities.

### Leading The Way In Medical Excellence

As a Level 3 (of 5) Trauma Center — the only one outside of Flagstaff in Northern Arizona - and the
only Cancer Center across Indian Country outside of Alaska, we promise to uphold a safe environment,
dedicated to quality, and a vision of excellence for today and tomorrow.

* Home Care

* Laboratory

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

## [Trend Watch: The Plant-Based Pivot][154]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][155]

After years of explosive trial, sales of plant-based meat alternatives have leveled off or
declined.1 Flavor and texture challenges, paired with a growing unease about overprocessing, made it
difficult for the category to sustain momentum.

## [Trend Watch: Mad About Matcha][156]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][157]

Matcha has evolved from a traditional Japanese tea ceremony staple to one of the fastest-growing
beverage trends worldwide. This article explores the rise of matcha in cafés, social media, and food
products—while examining the science behind its health claims and the cultural roots behind the
green tea powder.

## [Nutrition Therapy for Chronic Critical Illness][158]

[Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][159]

Patients with chronic critical illness face profound nutrition challenges after the ICU. Targeted
nutrition therapy plays a critical role in recovery, functional improvement, and long-term outcomes.

## [Trend Watch: The Plant-Based Pivot][154]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][155]

After years of explosive trial, sales of plant-based meat alternatives have leveled off or
declined.1 Flavor and texture challenges, paired with a growing unease about overprocessing, made it
difficult for the category to sustain momentum.

## [Trend Watch: Mad About Matcha][156]

[Janet Helm, MS, RDN][Janet Helm, MS, RDN][157]

Matcha has evolved from a traditional Japanese tea ceremony staple to one of the fastest-growing
beverage trends worldwide. This article explores the rise of matcha in cafés, social media, and food
products—while examining the science behind its health claims and the cultural roots behind the
green tea powder.

## [Nutrition Therapy for Chronic Critical Illness][158]

[Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][Jennifer Doley, MBA, RD, CNSC, FAND][159]

Patients with chronic critical illness face profound nutrition challenges after the ICU. Targeted
nutrition therapy plays a critical role in recovery, functional improvement, and long-term outcomes.

## Your health, on your time

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.
* Manage your appointments
* View your test results
* Send messages to your doctor
* Request medication refills
* Pay your bill

[ Sign in or Sign Up ][29] [ What is MyUFHealth? ][30]
[Smart phone with MyUFHealth open in the browser app]

## Get the right care,
## when you need it
* ### Primary Care
  
  Choose from our network of highly skilled doctors and providers for your regular care.
  
  [ Find Adult Primary Care ][31] [ Find Pediatric Primary Care ][32]
* ### Specialty Care
  
  Our experts are here to treat your unique medical and surgical needs.
  
  [ Find Adult Specialty Care ][33] [ Find Pediatric Specialty Care ][34]
* ### Urgent Care
  
  Visit Urgent Care when you can't wait to be seen by your primary care provider.
  
  [ Find Urgent Care ][35]
* ### Emergency Care
  
  Our ER and trauma centers are available 24/7 for when you need immediate help.
  
  [ Find Emergency Care ][36]
* ### Dental Care
  
  We offer a complete range of dental and oral health care for adults and children.
  
  [ Find a Dentist ][37]

elite athletes with the same world-class health care that's available to you and your family.

## Your health, on your time

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.
* Manage your appointments
* View your test results
* Send messages to your doctor
* Request medication refills
* Pay your bill

[ Sign in or Sign Up ][29] [ What is MyUFHealth? ][30]
[Smart phone with MyUFHealth open in the browser app]

## Get the right care,
## when you need it
* ### Primary Care
  
  Choose from our network of highly skilled doctors and providers for your regular care.
  
  [ Find Adult Primary Care ][31] [ Find Pediatric Primary Care ][32]
* ### Specialty Care
  
  Our experts are here to treat your unique medical and surgical needs.
  
  [ Find Adult Specialty Care ][33] [ Find Pediatric Specialty Care ][34]
* ### Urgent Care
  
  Visit Urgent Care when you can't wait to be seen by your primary care provider.
  
  [ Find Urgent Care ][35]
* ### Emergency Care
  
  Our ER and trauma centers are available 24/7 for when you need immediate help.
  
  [ Find Emergency Care ][36]
* ### Dental Care
  
  We offer a complete range of dental and oral health care for adults and children.
  
  [ Find a Dentist ][37]

We’ve joined the **U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Medical Network**, where we're now providing Team USA's
elite athletes with the same world-class health care that's available to you and your family.

GMP CDMO focused on different stages of the process.

We work exclusively in lentivirus, offering comprehensive services.

### Customized service

Technical adaptation and timely slot availability for each project.

Compliance with EMA and FDA regulatory requirements.

история создания, достижения, цифры
**В конце июня 2025 года** был дан «Старт» новому направлению в переработке **– запущен в
эксплуатацию Завод технических фабрикатов.** Это завод по переработке боенских отходов. На сегодня
произведены пуско-наладочные работы, произведена работа по отладке технологических процессов нового
производства.
Созданные производственные номинальные мощности ЗТФ:
**Цель создания ЗТФ** – обеспечение биобезопасности производств АПХ, самостоятельная переработка
боенских отходов, образующихся на предприятиях АПХ "Дороничи".
Описание производства
Линия по приёму пера 9 тонн/сутки, производство 2,7 тонн перьевой муки/сутки;
Две линии по приёму крови суммарно 8,8 тонн/сутки, и производству 0,7 тонн кровяной муки/сутки;
Суммарно производственная номинальная мощность ЗТФ = 73,7 тонн сырья в сутки или 19,9 тонны ГП в
сутки, **23 000 тонн сырья /год**.
Линия по приёму боенских отходов курицы 21,5 тонн/сутки, производство 3,6 тонн куриной муки/сутки и
2,2 тонн куриного жира/сутки;
Линия по приёму боенских отходов свинины 34,4 тонн/сутки, производство 6,7 тонн свиной муки/сутки и
4 тонны свиного жира/сутки;

## потому что мы

* Бережно относимся к вашему бюджету и времени
  Не назначаем избыточных исследований и бесполезных лекарств
* Работаем по международным стандартам
  И гарантируем высокий уровень качества оказываемых услуг
* Придерживаемся принципов доказательной медицины
  Рекомендуем только те методы лечения, диагностики и профилактики, которые доказали свою
  эффективность и безопасность
* Заботимся о здоровье детей и взрослых
  Всегда внимательно слушаем и подробно отвечаем на все вопросы
* Действуем в интересах пациентов
  И придерживаемся отношений как с равноправными партнерами
* Заботимся о вашей безопасности
  Изолированная часть клиники для остро заболевших пациентов
* Прислушиваемся к мнению пациентов
  Регулярно проводим опросы о качестве услуг и сервиса, и внедряем изменения
* Ведем строгий отбор специалистов

## О клинике

**Лечим так, как хотели бы, чтобы лечили нас. **
**ЧТО ВДОХНОВЛЯЕТ КОМАНДУ MEDICAL HOME?**

Мы сталкиваемся с болезнями каждый день, поэтому понимаем, насколько ценна жизнь и ее качество. И
когда люди доверяют нам, они вправе требовать самого лучшего. Вот почему стремление к высоким
стандартам и обеспечение безопасности лежит в основе всего, что мы делаем.
23
направления медицинской деятельности
Обеспечить доступную и высококачественную, современную и экономически эффективную медицинскую помощь
любому пациенту с учетом его перспектив и потребностей, но вне зависимости от его приверженности тем
или иным представлениям о здоровье и гендере, политическим и религиозным взглядам.
Миссия клиники
Наше видение Medical Home состоит в том, чтобы быть высокоэффективной клиникой, известной своим
превосходством в предоставлении первичной и специализированной медицинской помощи, где пациенты
чувствуют настоящую заботу и получают всестороннюю поддержку; местом, где люди хотят работать,
чувствовать себя ценными и что они могут реально изменить ситуацию.

Вообще Екатерина Дмитриевна в рекламе не нуждается. Но очень хочется поблагодарить ее еще раз! За 7

не подтвердилось.

клинике. У меня старший почти не привит, а у младшего одна БЦЖ. Так вот, доктор Катя стала первым
врачом, у которого я бы хотела вакцинировать своих детей и кому бы я их доверила на 100%.
